Driver Input Analysis

Flying laps only. Brake is shown as % of the session's peak so it works even if the sensor scaling is off.

TRACTION CIRCLE & TRAIL BRAKING

How much of the tyres' grip the driver uses — and whether braking blends into cornering.

Show
● Braking (straight) ● Trail braking ● Mid-corner ● On throttle ● Coasting - - Grip limit this session
How to read it
Every dot is one moment on track. Down = braking, up = accelerating, left/right = cornering. The farther a dot is from the centre, the harder the tyres are working. The dashed line is the most grip the car showed all session.
Trail braking means easing off the brake while turning in, so braking grip hands over to cornering grip without a gap. It shows up as purple dots filling the bottom corners of the circle. If those corners are empty, the driver finishes braking in a straight line and then turns — grip is left unused at turn-in.
